name: com.bussim.obstacles
description: Seeded, always-passable random road obstacles for a Singapore bus driver training simulator: spline road, obstacle catalog (cones, road works, debris, stalled and double-parked vehicles, jaywalkers, elderly crossers, cyclists, filtering motorcycles, cutting-in cars, school and bus stop hazards), clearance validator, difficulty profiles and a simple test bus.

samples.description: How to build the demo scene with one menu command.
